title: Scalar trace base change to the first projective projection
statement: Fix the admissible rational or closure coefficient data $l,c,k,p,Y$, the noetherian and diagonal-trace localization hypotheses, and a coefficient family with its whole-system completed reference [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference]. Let $d$ be its selected diagram, $T=L_P[2]$, $N=L_W[2]$, $b_T:q^*Rq_*T\to Rp_{1*}N$ the opposite mate with the root-normalized secondLineComparison [def-sfb-rational-p1-first-trace-data], $t_q:Rq_*T\to\mathbf1_Y$ its native q trace followed by singleUnitIso, and $t_1:Rp_{1*}N\to\mathbf1_P$ its native first trace followed by singleUnitIso. Then $b_Tt_1=q^*(t_q)u_q$, where $u_q:q^*\mathbf1_Y\simeq\mathbf1_P$ is the canonical monoidal unit comparison. No arbitrary object M or projection-isomorphism assumption is present.

proof.text: Apply the completed trace-pullback theorem to q and the first projection of its self-product, with reference.tq, reference.t1 and their normalized realizations. The inverse self-square mate and second-line comparison are the two square boundaries.

Paste the completed realization trace squares with the integral, rational, and closure scalar trace squares recorded by Family. Uniqueness of adjunction mates and the ordinary root normalization identify the transported mate with firstTraceExchange. Naturality of the unit comparisons gives the displayed equality. This is the scalar part of the source argument and contains no inverse projection or general M.

theorem first_scalar_trace
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (family : Family l Y) (reference : Reference l Y δ family) :
    firstTraceExchange (coefficient l c).X Y
        (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y))
          0).obj (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
        (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules (coefficient l c).X (diagonalSurface Y))
          0).obj (line l c (diagonalSurface Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
        (secondLineComparison l c k p hpl Y) ≫
      firstNativeFunctional (coefficient l c).X Y (line l c) (diagram l c Y family)
        (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules (coefficient l c).X (diagonalSurface Y))
          0).obj (line l c (diagonalSurface Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
        (diagram l c Y family).trace₁ ≫
      (singleUnitIso (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)).hom =
    (moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).map
      (trace (coefficient l c).X Y (line l c) (diagram l c Y family) ≫
        (singleUnitIso (coefficient l c).X Y).hom) ≫
      (secondTraceUnitIso (coefficient l c).X Y).hom
